attempt_history.llm_sketch:
The workflow validates successfully. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_ft_007
steps:
  - id: authenticate
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      token: "{{request.auth_token}}"
    output: user_context

  - id: read_fitness_profile
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: user_fitness_profiles
      filter:
        user_id: "{{user_context.user_id}}"
      fields:
        - fitness_goals
        - fitness_level
        - available_equipment
        - health_restrictions
    output: fitness_profile

  - id: read_workout_history
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: workout_history
      filter:
        user_id: "{{user_context.user_id}}"
      sort_by: completed_at
      sort_order: desc
      limit: 30
    output: recent_workouts

  - id: merge_user_data
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      sources:
        - "{{fitness_profile}}"
        - "{{recent_workouts}}"
    output: merged_user_data

  - id: generate_weekly_plan
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      url: "{{env.AI_MODEL_ENDPOINT}}/generate-workout-plan"
      method: POST
      body:
        fitness_goals: "{{merged_user_data.fitness_goals}}"
        fitness_level: "{{merged_user_data.fitness_level}}"
        available_equipment: "{{merged_user_data.available_equipment}}"
        health_restrictions: "{{merged_user_data.health_restrictions}}"
        recent_workouts: "{{merged_user_data.recent_workouts}}"
        plan_duration: weekly
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {{env.AI_SERVICE_API_KEY}}"
    output: generated_plan

  - id: validate_plan_schema
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      data: "{{generated_plan}}"
      schema: weekly_workout_plan_schema
    output: schema_validation_result

  - id: validate_safety
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: workout_safety_check
      conditions:
        - field: "{{generated_plan.max_intensity}}"
          operator: lte
          value: "{{fitness_profile.fitness_level}}"
        - field: "{{generated_plan.total_weekly_volume}}"
          operator: lte
          value: "{{fitness_profile.max_weekly_volume}}"
        - field: "{{generated_plan.exercises}}"
          operator: not_in
          value: "{{fitness_profile.health_restrictions}}"
    output: safety_validation_result

  - id: handle_validation_failure
    op: handle_error
    params:
      condition: "{{safety_validation_result.passed == false}}"
      message: "Generated plan exceeds user capability range or violates safety constraints."
      action: terminate

  - id: deactivate_previous_plan
    op: write_database
    params:
      table: training_plans
      operation: update
      filter:
        user_id: "{{user_context.user_id}}"
        status: active
      values:
        status: inactive
        deactivated_at: "{{now}}"
    output: deactivation_result

  - id: store_new_plan
    op: write_database
    params:
      table: training_plans
      operation: insert
      values:
        user_id: "{{user_context.user_id}}"
        plan_data: "{{generated_plan}}"
        status: active
        created_at: "{{now}}"
        valid_from: "{{now}}"
        valid_until: "{{now + 7d}}"
    output: stored_plan

  - id: log_plan_creation
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: weekly_plan_generated
      user_id: "{{user_context.user_id}}"
      details:
        plan_id: "{{stored_plan.id}}"
        replaced_plan: "{{deactivation_result.updated_ids}}"

  - id: notify_user_plan_ready
    op: notify_user
    params:
      user_id: "{{user_context.user_id}}"
      channel: push
      title: "Your New Weekly Workout Plan is Ready!"
      message: "Your personalized weekly workout plan has been generated and is now active. Open the app to view your schedule."
